title: Roadmap
intro: What is coming next to GlassFolio. Horizons are indicative and may change as the project evolves.

assetClasses.title: New asset classes
assetClasses.body: Precious metals, private equity and collectibles, each valued automatically when a market price exists or manually on your own schedule.

manualEntry.title: Manual transaction entry
manualEntry.body: Record a purchase, a sale or a dividend directly in the app, alongside CSV import.

aiImport.title: AI-assisted import
aiImport.body: Let the assistant read an unfamiliar CSV export and propose the column mapping for you to confirm.

liabilities.title: Loans and liabilities
liabilities.body: Track mortgages and consumer loans to see your net worth after debts.

wealthProjection.title: Long-term wealth projection
wealthProjection.body: Simulate portfolio trajectories and retirement milestones across multi-year scenarios with customizable contribution rates and compound returns.

brokerSync.title: Direct broker connections
brokerSync.body: Refresh positions straight from supported brokers and exchanges, without exporting files.

jurisdictions.title: New tax jurisdictions
jurisdictions.body: Extend the modular tax engine beyond France, starting with the countries most requested by users.

disclaimer: Already shipped features are listed in the changelog.
